details.detail: Seat and niche in centre suites (fix verified). SW = min(0.72, room) gives a 0.63 seat in the 1.10 m centre suite. c_front shows the seat, jambs and header following it with no armrest overlap. The lit literature niche is gone (no white notch in seat_front), and the coat rail now sits flush against the wardrobe face.
Reading spots (fix verified). A chrome ring round a dark lens now reads as lamps that are off, matching f9 and f46.

Window-suite screen wall. The 0.10 rounded wood wing, the small taupe shelf, and the pier with its lighter taupe-rimmed pill mirror (no longer a black-navy slot) match f10 in q03 and w_screen. The pier-top cap closes the triangle, so no dark notch shows from above. The pier is still narrower than in f10, where it is about 0.3 of the screen width.

Centre-suite fins (new, but faulty). There is now wood between the 1D/1G screens, which f3 and f4 show. However, the two fins CROSS in an X instead of forming a V, and their taupe caps make a visible X on top (q02 x 430-490 y 115-140; c_screen2 shows two separate boards). Real photos show one plain wood panel, angled, with no taupe cap.

Forward aisle hood (new). From the aisle (q02) it adds bulk to the corner. It does not reproduce f4/f3: the real hood is one smooth arm that overhangs FORWARD past the screen plane and out over the aisle, with a thick rounded underside. From inside the suite (q03, w_inside, c_screen) it reads as a rolled bolster or tube lying on the cap, with a seam and a pinched end over the pier. In f10 the corner top is a clean, flat taupe sweep.

Aisle door leaves. The 0.055 stiles and rails, the rounded ribs at 0.019 pitch and the frame tone read closer to pb_20 and f4 in the studio (s1, w_aisle). Moire is reduced but not gone. The studio head-on view w_aisle has wavy vertical bands across the right leaf. At cabin distance (q02 x 700-930) the ribs become a fish-scale or woven texture instead of clean vertical lines.

Headrest flap. It now hangs from the top edge and wraps over it, which is right. The tone is still off. In seat_front the flap is RGB 90/96/101 against a back of 73/67/61: 1.4x lighter and clearly blue. In f9 it is 145/146/141 against 128/121/113: 1.17x and neutral grey, cooler only relative to the warm back. The result reads as a framed glass pane (c_front, seat_front).
Seat pillow (lavender). It is plumper than the old slab, but still octagonal and faceted in c_front and seat_front.

Bed. The white pillow is now propped against the niche, as in f46. The lavender pillow is tilted almost as steeply (-55 deg against -60 deg), so it stands nearly upright and merges into the white one (q04 crop). In f46 it lies low and almost flat in front. The pad and duvet are unchanged and fine.
Console, tray and ottoman. The warm tray wood (#4a3d33) now matches f47. The keypad, handset, fascia and ottoman are unchanged and good.
Walls, caps and centre divider. These are unchanged and consistent with f3, f5 and f7.
Seat plaque. The flush taupe slot is right. The text is still white (known; pending the integrator shader change).

issues.problem: The centre-screen fins intersect each other in an X, and their taupe caps cross on top
issues.detail: fin = M4.trs(-hx+0.03, 0, -L+0.15, -18*DEG), then the panel is offset +0.14 in local z (0.28 deep). A -18 deg yaw moves the aft end by 0.28*sin(-18) = -0.087 in x, so it runs to -hx-0.057, which is 5.7 cm into the neighbouring suite. The mirrored partner does the same in the other direction. The two panels cross about 0.1 m aft of the screen wall and interpenetrate, and the two 0.03 m caps form a visible X.
issues.evidence: q02_suiteAisle.png x 420-490 y 110-320 (zoom: X-shaped caps, two panels crossing). c_screen2.png x 140-200: two boards side by side. In real omaat_f3 (2D/2G) and f4 (1D/1G) there is ONE plain dark-wood panel with no taupe cap.
issues.fix: In the center branch of suiteUnit, flip the yaw to +18*DEG so each fin's aft end stays in its own suite (the pair then forms a V that opens aft and meets at the screen wall). Alternatively, build one fin per pair: only when !mir, at x = -hx, thickness 0.025, yaw about 15 deg. Remove the fCap strip on the fin top, or replace it with a 3 mm fWood edge a shade lighter.

issues.problem: The forward aisle 'hood' reads as a tube or bolster lying on the cap, not as a cantilevered hood
issues.detail: gRBox(0.13, 0.085, 0.40, r 0.04) at H+0.02 sits on top of the existing cap and ends at z = -L+0.03. It does not overhang forward, and it has rounded ends on both sides plus a seam against the cap. From inside the suite its inner half pokes over the pier as a pinched sausage.
issues.evidence: q03_suite1A.png x 700-840 y 85-135 (zoom: rolled tube with a pinched end over the pier lamp). w_inside.png and c_screen.png: a double knob at the corner. The real omaat_f4 and f3 show one smooth arm that overhangs forward past the screen plane and toward the aisle. From inside (omaat_f10) the corner top is a flat taupe sweep.
issues.fix: Replace the separate box with an extruded or lofted L-profile that REPLACES cap(0.04, 0.50, ...) at the corner: flat top flush at H+0.0625, 0.16 wide (flush with the wardrobe inner face so nothing shows above the pier), extending from z = -L+0.60 to about -L-0.06 (overhanging forward past the screen wall), with a 0.10 deep rounded underside only at the forward and aisle edges. Keep the inner edge square and flush with the pier-top cap.

issues.problem: The door ribs still alias (wavy bands and fish-scale texture)
issues.detail: About 23 ribs 0.011 wide at 0.019 pitch per leaf are still sub-pixel beyond about 1.5 m. Lowering the contrast helped but did not remove the pattern.
issues.evidence: w_aisle.png right leaf x 440-545: wavy moire bands. q02_suiteAisle.png x 700-930: fish-scale or woven texture. Real pb_20 and omaat_f4 show crisp vertical ribs.
issues.fix: In the cabin (non-studio) build, draw each leaf as one gQuad with a mipmapped 'flute' atlas stripe (about 23 periods, rib highlight plus groove), and keep the geometric ribs only for opts.studio or close LOD. If no atlas slot is available, drop to about 12 ribs at 0.036 pitch with 0.02 ribs in the cabin build.

issues.problem: The headrest flap is too light and too blue
issues.detail: fFlap #7a7e80 (LAYER.leather) renders at 1.4x the back luminance with B > R by 11. In the photos it is 1.17x and neutral.
issues.evidence: seat_front.png flap 90/96/101 against back 73/67/61. omaat_f9 flap 145/146/141 against back 128/121/113.
issues.fix: Set fFlap to about '#76766f' (neutral, very slightly warm) in SEATMAT (09_seats.js, one line).

issues.problem: The bed's lavender pillow stands nearly upright, merged into the white pillow
issues.detail: The lavender pillow is tilted -55 deg against -60 deg for the white one, and sits 0.11 forward.
issues.evidence: q04_suite1Abed.png x 90-300 y 150-310. In omaat_f46 the lavender pillow lies low, at about 15-20 deg, in front of the upright white one.

issues.problem: The seat pillow is octagonal and faceted
issues.detail: The SEC sections with a large corner radius, only 5 sections and 3 subdivisions leave visible flat facets.
issues.evidence: c_front.png and seat_front.png: lavender pillow with chamfered corners. omaat_f9: a soft rectangle with small corner radii.
issues.fix: Use corner radius 0.02-0.03 in the middle SECs, add 2 intermediate sections, and subdivide 4.

issues.problem: The interior renders darker than the photos, and sun patches wash out the bed (lighting area, not suite)
issues.detail: This is carried over from w2.
issues.evidence: q04_suite1Abed.png bed sun stripes. q03 ottoman.
